criteria.name: Hook strength
criteria.notes: First sentence alone names the May 20 adjournment, four bill numbers, and a concrete outcome (every bill dead); stands inside the see-more cutoff. Loses one point because the second line catalogs bills before the capital consequence arrives in paragraph two.

criteria.name: Industry relevance
criteria.notes: Every item has a named AK anchor and a specific industry consequence: governance vacuum to procurement/AV/healthcare ambiguity; RHTP $272M with June 22 deadline and ~$20M tranche; Sawmill Creek UAS integration mid-fire-season; Glenfarne $44.5B-54.5B and data-center power math; White House EO July 2 CISA clock.

criteria.notes: Specifics every one to two sentences: bill numbers, ADN May 28, HB 239 June 1/June 18, $272.2M/June 22/$20M/403, Sawmill Creek 14.8 acres May 20-22, Glenfarne June 3 $44.5-54.5B vs DOR $46.2B, EO June 2 CISA to July 2, 35th Legislature January.

criteria.notes: Governance vacuum backed by akleg.gov primary + ADN; RHTP by DOH + HHS TAGGS primaries; Sawmill by akfireinfo DFFP primaries + DroneXL; EO by whitehouse.gov primary. Glenfarne $44.5-54.5B rests effectively on one outlet (KTUU) with a URL-date discrepancy; post softens with 'Glenfarne disclosed' but the band is not independently confirmed, the one weak link.

criteria.name: Voice match
criteria.notes: Reads close to post_001: structural framing, contrarian pivot on the light-touch-win read, named lock-in consequence. No banned phrases or influencer cadence. Minor deduction for one slightly rhetorical bullet-lead sentence.

criteria.name: Readability (LinkedIn)
criteria.notes: Two-to-four-sentence paragraphs, one bullet block of three labeled single-clause items, 435 words / 2662 chars within bounds, scans cleanly on mobile.

criteria.notes: Names three specific actors (delegation, agencies, grant offices) tied to the vacuum-filling tension. No CTA or softener. Loses one point for menu-style framing rather than forcing a sharper consequence choice.
